_notes: Synthetic. The 3C-1 facts are the spec's stock Rocky 9 reading; the 3C-2a families are shaped like rockylinux/rockylinux:9-ubi-init measured on 2026-09-29 (V-18, V-23) - booted with systemd for units.*, with iputils, libcap, openssh-server and sudo installed - and carry env.container none, as the stock VM would.

walk.capabilities: the walk cannot run in a container (V-23), so its rows are what rpm -qa --qf's FILECAPS column declares there - iputils' arping and clockdiff (cap_net_raw=p; ping carries none) and shadow-utils' newgidmap and newuidmap (cap_setgid=ep, cap_setuid=ep). getcap -r /usr in the image listed only the two iputils files, which dnf had just installed; the image's own layer carries no security.capability on the shadow-utils pair, and rpm sets the header's capabilities when it installs a package on a host.
units.root_services is the init image's seventeen in-scope root services, six commands named without a path among them; a VM install runs more services shaped the same.

sshd.options.permit_root_login is the compiled default prohibit-password, which the image's 9.9p1 sshd prints through sshd -G as without-password and muster stores as prohibit-password; the persisted side, absent because 50-redhat.conf includes the crypto-policies file outside the declaration, is omitted here as no control reads it.
accounts.login_capable is root alone, locked, as the image has it; an installer-created wheel account would be a second unset row and change nothing.

3C-2b (hypothesis of spec §5, pinned before Task 7 measures): firewalld active, whose filter_INPUT chain accepts by default with rules, so the normaliser reads partial and exposure.exposed is absent with that cause while sshd listens on 0.0.0.0 and :: (tcp/22) - muster.beyond.exposed_listeners_allowed reads MANUAL; chronyd's 127.0.0.1 and ::1 sockets are the two loopback listeners. Every listener is rpm-owned and no process runs a deleted executable. The net.sysctl runtime side cannot be measured in a container (it reads the namespace's values), so these rows carry the persisted winners of 50-default.conf - default.rp_filter 2 and default.accept_source_route 0, its glob excluded from all.accept_source_route and all.rp_filter - over the kernel's defaults as the hypothesis for the runtime side, until an EL VM is measured.
